visual.general_description: Growth chart of weight against gestational age with percentile curves, a red trace and a green "CRT start" arrow at 32 weeks.
visual.detailed_description: A growth chart with gestational age in weeks on the x axis (printed ticks 22 to 50 in steps of 2) and weight in grams on the y axis (printed ticks 0 to 6000 in steps of 500) over a fine grid. Several smooth blue percentile curves rise from lower left to upper right, labeled at the right "75th", "50th" (red curve), "25th", "10th" and "3rd", with the top label partly cut off. A thick red line with x markers starts near 650 g at about 24 weeks, dips slightly, rises to roughly 1100 to 1200 g by about 26 to 27 weeks, stays nearly flat to about 32 weeks, then rises steadily along the lower curves to about 3900 g at about 46 weeks. A green upward arrow at 32 weeks points to a boxed label "CRT start" near the bottom. A vertical printed code runs along the right edge. No chart title is visible.
